title: ApprovalRequest
description: Matches governance.approval.ApprovalRequest.to_dict(). One row is written per state transition (append-only, matching the capabilities/history.jsonl and router/decisions.jsonl convention already used in this repository) -- the current state of an approval is the latest row for a given approval_id, not a single mutable record.

requested_by.description: Actor that requested the approval, e.g. 'agent:claude-code-session'. Never the same actor that may decide it -- see decided_by.

target.description: Same shape as an AuthorityObject's 'scope' -- what specifically this approval, if granted, would authorize.

reason.description: Why this approval is being requested.

risk.description: Caller-assessed risk tier; informs how urgently a human should review it.

proposed_action.description: Concrete description of the action that would be taken if approved, e.g. 'git push origin NRM-v0.1-CLASSROOM'.

evidence_summary.description: Snapshot of the AuthorityDecision.evidence that led here, for the human reviewer's context.

status.description: See governance.types.ApprovalStatus. EXECUTED is terminal and one-shot: an approval backs exactly one execution (governance/approval.py mark_executed()).

decided_by.description: Must be a human actor id -- governance/approval.py decide_approval() raises PermissionError if decider_kind != 'human'.

expires_at.description: A PENDING request past this timestamp reads as EXPIRED (lazy expiry, computed at read time).
